lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white line segments visible across the lateral torso with relatively uniform spacing of approximately 15-20 pixels between segments in the mid-section.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line segment is significantly abbreviated, terminating at approximately 30% of the torso height; multiple posterior lines show tapering discontinuities near the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized cluster of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the posterior haunch, superior to the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white horizontal patches visible on the carpal joints of the forelimbs and tarsal regions of the hind limbs; distinct dark pigmentation on the interior of the pinna.
